title.zh: 所有智能的普遍元伦理

scope.zh: 原普遍智能会话及其明确授权接续，不自动成为每个仓库任务目标。
scope.en: The original universal-intelligence session and explicitly authorized continuations; not automatically every repository task’s objective.

objective.zh: 证明所有智能的普遍元伦理，说明整体相依与其中差异化行动能力的形成。 8日最新接续明确采用G0，从关系中形成的个体位置及当前有根据的可见未来，建立正面生成意义与可修订的实践方向。 Ren 于8日将理论命名为 Universal Meta-Ethics of Agency、规范核心命名为 Universal Metaethical Core；9日将理论改称 The Theory of Becoming，核心名称保留；公开 README 优先展示已成立的结论及其有范围证据。
objective.en: Prove universal metaethics of all intelligence, explaining interconnection and differentiated agency formed within the whole. The latest 8 October continuation uses G0 to establish positive generative warrant and revisable practical direction from formed relational positions and supported visible futures. On 8 October Ren named the theory Universal Meta-Ethics of Agency and its normative core Universal Metaethical Core; on 9 October Ren renamed the theory The Theory of Becoming, keeping the core's name; the public README leads with established conclusions and their scoped evidence.

premises.zh: 规范普遍性、实际遵循和当前表述的唯一必要性必须分别论证。 保留真实生成可能与新证据纠正判断两层开放；完整积分、全知和整体严格改善不是正面根据的前提。
premises.en: Normative universality, actual compliance and exclusive necessity of this formulation need separate arguments. Preserve both real generative possibilities and evidence-responsive revision; complete integration, omniscience and strict whole improvement are not premises of positive warrant.

completion.zh: 不能以局部生成定理、给定价值保存或有限比较宣告普遍目标完成。 本次有限正面原则按其明确前提验收；不得把全面总排序、所有后果无损或必然服从另设为该原则的完成条件。
completion.en: A local generative theorem, preservation of supplied value or bounded comparison does not complete the universal target. Assess the current finite positive principle under its explicit premises; do not add a complete ranking, losslessness of every consequence or inevitable compliance as its completion gate.

title.zh: 继续发展普遍元伦理核心

summary.en: We are developing the Universal Metaethical Core into increasingly specific ethics. G0 and explicit practical commitments already support comparison, basic protection, bounded responsibility, transfer and appropriate ending. Current extensions address conflicting claims, uncertain classification and revisable judgment.
summary.zh: 我们继续将普遍元伦理核心展开为更具体的伦理。G0 与公开实践承诺已经支持比较、基本保护、有界责任、交接及适当结束；当前接续处理冲突要求、不确定分类和可修订判断。

next_step.en: Extend justified comparisons where serious losses and fair chances conflict; establish the particular living relationships that change a concrete choice, including when a changed situation warrants revising an undertaking.
next_step.zh: 推进严重损失与公平机会交叉时的有根据比较；辨明足以改变具体选择的生活关系，包括何种情境变化足以正当地修订承担。
